description: Structural requirements for all compiled React components

rules.description: Component must be exported as a named export matching the component name
rules.check: export { ComponentName } or export function ComponentName or export const ComponentName

rules.description: Component must also be the default export
Props must be typed via a TypeScript interface named {ComponentName}Props
Component must have displayName set for DevTools
If component renders a DOM element it must use forwardRef
No style={{ }} attributes on elements — use className only
index.ts must re-export the component and its types
